questions.label: What is the population this service will serve?
questions.help: Use the country population, or the relevant subset if the service is sectoral (e.g. number of registered businesses).

questions.label: How many services do you plan to launch in year 1?
questions.help: A service is a single citizen-facing procedure (e.g. business registration, building permit).

questions.label: How many applications do you expect per year?
questions.help: Total submissions across all services in a typical operational year.

questions.label: How often do applications require document uploads?
questions.help: Scanned IDs, photos, contracts — anything that ends up stored as a file.

questions.label: What planning horizon are you sizing for?
questions.help: How many years of growth the server should comfortably absorb before upgrade.

questions.label: Which environments do you need?
questions.help: Production is required. Dev and Test are optional and roughly one-third the size of Production.

questions.label: Where will PostgreSQL run?
questions.help: The installer standard is PostgreSQL 18 on the same server. Choose externally managed only if your ministry or provider operates a managed database service.

questions.label: Where will MongoDB run?
questions.help: The installer runs MongoDB on the same server — as a host install (Ubuntu 24.04) or a container (Ubuntu 26.04). Choose externally managed for a hosted service such as Atlas.
